howToEdit: Change centerLat, centerLong, claimRadius or battlefieldRadius in this file, then restart the website. One lat-long unit is 10 metres. Claim radius must stay smaller than battlefield radius. These circles are a small part of the named Gateway region, not the whole nearest-anchor area. Do not delete rows from territory_holdings; remove a territory from this list to disable it and leave its history in place.
